normalization.legacyColors: hsl(source HSL triplet), with no rounding or conversion
normalization.legacySidebar: explicit aliases to same-palette background/foreground/primary/accent/border/ring; the legacy files do not define sidebar tokens
normalization.radius: each modern light radius retained in dark; legacy palettes use neutral.light.radius
normalization.geometry: upstream component classes and multiplicative radius bindings from apps/v4/assets/css/main.css; no geometry corrections to match QDS

intentionalComparisonAdaptations.font: shared src/fonts/inter.css and its local woff2 files; no QDS reset, tokens, CSS, or runtime
intentionalComparisonAdaptations.icons: Vite @lucide/vue import alias to Phosphor regular named equivalents; no component source edits; not a Lucide silhouette oracle
intentionalComparisonAdaptations.sidebar: upstream noncollapsible fixture, explicit open=true/defaultOpen=true; no cookie-dependent fixture state; random SidebarMenuSkeleton is not rendered
intentionalComparisonAdaptations.capture: capture=1 or setCapture(true) disables animation/transition/caret painting only; normal mode retains upstream motion

automation.readiness: hook.ready and html[data-reference-ready=true], after local font loading, Vue nextTick and two animation frames
automation.isolation: separate document/origin or iframe only; never import reference CSS into the Quasar gallery
automation.network: dev/build/runtime use committed files only; --acquire is the sole explicit upstream network maintenance action

dependencyOwnership: private package.json only; existing examples/* workspace glob already includes this app. Parent T178 owns lock integration and optional root script aliases before dependency installation.

parentScriptRequests.shadcn-reference:check: pnpm -C examples/shadcn-reference check:source && pnpm -C examples/shadcn-reference typecheck
parentScriptRequests.shadcn-reference:test: pnpm -C examples/shadcn-reference build && pnpm -C examples/shadcn-reference test:reference

limitations: Legacy Gray/Slate are officially sourced legacy palettes applied to v4 geometry, not missing modern OKLCH palette definitions.
Legacy sidebar slots are source-value aliases, not an upstream Gray/Slate sidebar-specific theme.
This reference preserves upstream contrast, including failures; it is not a QDS accessibility-conformance assertion.
Sidebar fixture covers native noncollapsible anatomy; responsive mobile sheet behavior is vendored but not a screenshot fixture.
Buttons in card/footer are deterministic visual actions, not business operations.
